name: Bardenhagen Berries Farm
tagline: Bardenhagen Farms — Local Farm Fresh Fruit
description: Bardenhagen Berries Farm is an on-farm market in 7900 E Horn Rd, MI, selling produce straight from the field. Because everything is sold where it is grown, selection follows the local harvest calendar. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
